Mistral AI released open weights for Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk), a 1T-parameter model with 52B active parameters. While open weights provide crucial sovereign control and auditability for frontier models, self-hosting architectures of this magnitude demand strict memory optimization and infrastructure validation to prevent silent bottlenecks in production. #AI #MachineLearning #Infra
